basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Toronto who loves metal music, especially Cannibal Corpse. I spend my weekdays working as a software developer and my weekends catching up on the latest Real Madrid matches. When I'm not coding or watching football, I dive deep into neural networks and AI research as a hobby. Typically, I'm online in the evenings, usually between 8 PM and midnight, Eastern Time. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom it gives me to explore my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in software development and artificial intelligence. I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over a decade. My interest in AI is mostly self-taught through online courses and reading research papers.
